text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the biggest race of the autumn
season:
the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think, Trainer? Am I looking

ultra-sharp?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's my big day! Gotta show off how
much I've
grown!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I trained and trained and finally made it
here!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. And you've grown a lot more
trainer-like!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm off! I'm gonna give it
everything I've got!
